Business Unit
Tencent Games was established in 2003. We are a leading global platform for game development, operations and publishing, and the largest online game community in China.
Tencent Games has developed and operated over 140 games. We provide cross-platform interactive entertainment experience for more than 800 million users in over 200 countries and regions around the world. Honor of Kings, PUBG MOBILE, and League of Legends, are some of our most popular titles around the world.
Meanwhile, we actively promote the development of esports industry, work with global partners to build an open, collaborative and symbiotic industrial ecology, and create high-quality digital life experiences for players.

About the Hiring Team
Game Research Center(GRC) is a department focusing on game industry study, game analysis, game design research, data analysis and game development supporting. We’re one of the world’s leading research facility in game industry, building a global knowledge tank to help our teams make better decisions. We’re looking for innovative and passionate team members who love all kinds of games and have insight about the challenging global market.

What the Role Entails
This role sits within the GRC (Game Research Center) team. Its core mission is to bring in a highly authoritative game design leader with extensive hands-on development experience across global shooter, SOC, and multiplayer online games.
We are looking for a true genre expert who can help define the next generation of gameplay standards. This individual will provide Tencent’s overseas portfolio with stronger strategic direction on product design trends, solve critical design challenges in active development, and identify opportunities for the next evergreen game franchise.
Key Responsibilities1. Gameplay and Systems DesignDefine and refine best-in-class minute-to-minute gameplay experience, including controls, movement, and player feedback across visual, audio, and haptic layers. 
Build scalable and deeply engaging combat systems, covering melee and ranged combat, physics-based interactions, and skill / build balance. 
Lead the design of innovative game modes, such as asymmetrical gameplay, PvPvE extraction modes, and dynamic objective-based loops. 
Ensure systems are accessible, strategically deep, highly replayable, and fun over the long term. 
2. Genre Expertise and Design BenchmarkingAnalyze leading global games in shooter, SOC, and multiplayer categories, and turn those insights into reusable design frameworks. 
Set high-quality design benchmarks for core projects, including 3C, system interaction, and world exploration pacing. 
3. Project Support and EvaluationWork directly with project teams to solve critical design problems, especially in GaaS systems, gameplay innovation, and economy balance. 
Review prototypes and milestone builds to ensure projects are both fun and distinctive in the global market. 
4. Industry LeadershipRepresent the company through thought leadership at industry events such as GDC, Devcom, and similar conferences. 
Use your industry reputation and network to connect with top global design talent and strengthen Tencent’s influence in game development. 

Who We Look For
Experience10+ years of experience in game design. with at least the past 5 years spent as a lead designer or core systems owner on globally recognized large-scale game projects.
Proven success in at least two of the following areas: Shooter games
SOC / survival games
Multiplayer online games
Experience working on major global IPs or well-known live game franchises. 
Strong industry recognition, ideally demonstrated through thought leadership and speaking engagements at major industry conferences or forums. 
Core SkillsStrong ability to design systems from the ground up that support long-term player engagement. 
Deep understanding of gameplay loops such as progression, survival, combat, and extraction. 
Strong expertise in 3C feel, including responsiveness, combat impact, camera, and audiovisual feedback. 
Strong understanding of hardcore players, competitive fairness, and player communities. 
Soft SkillsFluent English, with the ability to work effectively with global development teams. 
Strong structured thinking: able to turn creative ideas into clear design documents and system models. 
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a practical and supportive approach. 

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Netherlands-Amsterdam | UK-London
